- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kings Canyon National Park's Azalea Campground and Sunset Campground are near the General Grant Grove of giant sequoias.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mount Diablo State Park's Live Oak Campground has views of the San Francisco Bay Area.
